name: sample_edit_undo
title: Sample edit on instrument 1 of t-v16: REVERSE, UNDO, REDO, UNDO, NORMALISE, UNDO; the history says so (UNDONE / REDONE / NOTHING TO UNDO); `inst 1` is printed before / after for the sum; never saved

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)
a pad on the Sample edit screen picks the instrument: 1
the sample of instrument 1 is bound (else this scenario has nothing to edit)
(before: this soft failure PRINTS the unit's `inst 1` line: compare its `sum` and `len` by eye)
the sample's own undo on an empty history

steps.say: REVERSE (F3): a job on the main loop, committed when it is done; the engine takes it with the transport stopped

steps.note: (after REVERSE: this soft failure PRINTS the unit's `inst 1` line: compare its `sum` and `len` by eye)
UNDO: the reverse was a step of the sample's history (the peaks job that follows an edit posts PEAKS_<name>_DONE over UNDONE within a second: both are right)
(after UNDO: the sum is the first one again: this soft failure PRINTS the unit's `inst 1` line: compare its `sum` and `len` by eye)

steps.say: NORMALISE (F2): then UNDO (soft: an already normalised sample says NOTHING TO NORMALISE and makes no step)

steps.note: (soft: UNDONE or the peaks job after it means normalise made a step)
(after UNDO of NORMALISE: the same sum again: this soft failure PRINTS the unit's `inst 1` line: compare its `sum` and `len` by eye)
the history is empty: the sample is as loaded

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
